warnings.headline: Yellow Wind in the alpine region Northern Lapland Mountains
warnings.description:
During the night towards Monday, the southwest and west winds will increase, on the bare mountains very strong winds, on the high mountains storms. On Monday morning, there will also be snowfall that will turn into rain.; What happens?: During Monday, the wind will increase between a low pressure on the Arctic Ocean and a high pressure over southern Sweden. On the bare mountains 18-24 m/s, on the high mountains 23-30 m/s. Monday morning, mainly in the western mountains, also increasing snowfall that will turn into rain quite quickly. Smaller amounts are expected in the southern part of the warning area.
Wind and rain will ease overnight into Tuesday.; What should I think about?: Do not hike
warnings.sender: SMHI, Swedish Meteorological and Hydrological Institute
